thread:
marta: Quick heads upI'm opening a tiny docs PR to remove a legacy 429 example that encourages busy-loop retries. Found it in error-ref/429.md and a few SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4820
ken: can you paste the old snippet so reviewers can see the issue?
jules: here's the problematic code folks keep copying:```python
# BAD: busy-loop retry on 429
for _ in range(5):
    try:
        client.generate(...)
    except TooManyRequestsError:
        continue
```
patrick: yep, that's dangerous. we should show a backoff+jitter pattern and call out honoring Retry-After. also recommend fallbacks for latency-critical paths.
marta: draft replacement in PR uses the SDK v2 helper and adds guidance about when to fallback to smaller models. replacement snippet:```python
from redwood import Client, retry_with_backoff
client = Client()

@retry_with_backoff(max_retries=5, base=0.5, jitter=True)
def safe_generate(payload):
    return client.generate(payload)
```
ken: can we add a short JS/web SDK equivalent? many customers want browser examples.
jules: adding JS example now:```js
import { createClient, retryBackoff } from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = createClient();
await retryBackoff(() => client.text.generate({ prompt }), { maxRetries: 4 });
```
patrick: also include a tiny YAML showing fallback routing policy so customers know the config shape:```yaml
fallback_policy:
  prioritized_models: ["redwood-small", "redwood-medium"]
  target_latency_ms: 300
  max_fallback_depth: 2
```
ken: small nit: make it `target_latency_ms` and note it's a soft target. also add a note that Dedicated customers should configure fallbacks in the console rather than the YAML.
marta: done, updated PR and fixed internal links that referenced the old snippet (found two pages: /guides/client-best-practices and /sdk-migration). I also opened ticket #789 to add a docs-snippet linter rule to detect busy-loop patterns.
docs-bot: CI started for PR 4820  spellcheck, linkcheck, snippet-lint.
ci-bot: snippet-lint failed  detected raw `continue` inside codeblock flagged as busy-loop in error-ref/429.md (line 3).
marta: fixing those occurrences now and re-running checks locally.
ken: can eng-runtime glance at the wording around automatic fallbacks? we shouldn't imply we can fallback across capacity tiers without capacity checks.
patrick: agree. pinging eng-runtime for an ACK on the policy wording.
ken: reviewed and ACKed. small wording change: clarify `max_fallback_depth` is per-request and doesn't guarantee throughput.
marta: integrated that change, pushed, CI re-run queued.
docs-bot: CI green for PR 4820.
ken: once merged, backport a short note to the migration guide and add a one-line deprecation callout to the changelog.
jules: opened follow-up PR linking the migration guide to the new 429 guidance: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821
marta: merged PR, changelog entry added: "Deprecate busy-loop 429 example; add SDK retry_with_backoff snippets, JS example, and fallback policy YAML." :tada:
